messages:
sam_support: heads up — tenant reports console usage stopped updating around ~3:15 UTC, UI shows last datapoint at 00:00 UTC and hourly charts flat since then. customer says API calls succeeded though. any quick checks?
alex_sre: on it. can you paste a tenant id + example request id?
sam_support: tenant: acme-corp, request id: req_8f3b2a. customer says their app got 200s but tokens not attributed in console.
ciara_analytics: preliminary guess: aggregator/rollup job might be dropping messages with future timestamps or getting stuck in windowing. will check rollup metrics.
matt_backend: quick check — I see a flurry of incoming events in kafka around 03:05 UTC but consumer lag is spiking. consumer group: usage-rollup-consumer shows rebalances.
alex_sre: paste consumer lag output?
matt_backend: here:```
$ kafka-consumer-groups --group usage-rollup-consumer --describe --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092
TOPIC\tPARTITION\tCURRENT-OFFSET\tLOG-END-OFFSET\tLAG
usage-events\t0\t1254321\t1257899\t3578
usage-events\t1\t1254100\t1257701\t3601
usage-events\t2\t1255000\t1258600\t3600
```
sam_support: lag ~3.6k messages, roughly ~3 hours of events depending on throughput. customer timeframe matches.
ciara_analytics: are those messages stuck or being skipped by rollup? check consumer logs for errors.
alex_sre: grabbing logs from pod usage-rollup-0:```
2026-03-16T03:07:21Z ERROR RollupWorker - Unhandled exception processing partition 1: java.lang.IllegalStateException: Null window key
2026-03-16T03:07:21Z INFO  RollupWorker - Rebalancing triggered by exception
2026-03-16T03:08:02Z INFO  RollupWorker - Consumer group rejoined, resumed at offset 1254100
2026-03-16T03:09:05Z ERROR RollupWorker - Failed to write hourly aggregate for tenant acme-corp: timeout writing to aggregates db
```
matt_backend: looks like two issues: NPE-like Null window key (maybe bad event shape) causing rebalances, then DB write timeouts causing retries and further lag.
ciara_analytics: can we reconcile whether the messages are still in topic (not tombstoned) and whether backfill will pick them up?
alex_sre: all messages present. next step: patch consumer to ignore malformed events for now and restart pods in rolling fashion to avoid long rebalances. also investigate DB connectivity spike at 03:09.
sam_support: customer-facing note: I'll tell acme-corp we've identified an ingestion backlog caused by transient consumer errors and DB timeouts, working on restart + backfill. ETA?
matt_backend: if we do rolling restart now and DB recovers, consumer should catch up in ~40-60 minutes. if not, we trigger manual backfill job for affected partitions/tenant.
ciara_analytics: I'll queue a targeted re-aggregation job for acme-corp tenant id to run after consumers catch up to fill hourly rows. job id: reagg-20260316-001.
alex_sre: quick mitigation commands:```
# mark consumer to skip malformed messages for 1h
kubectl exec -it deploy/usage-rollup -- /bin/sh -c "export SKIP_MALFORMED=1 && kubectl rollout restart deploy/usage-rollup"
# monitor lag
kafka-consumer-groups --group usage-rollup-consumer --describe --bootstrap-server kafka.prod:9092 --watch
```
sam_support: pinging customer with plan: rolling restart + targeted backfill if lag doesn't clear in 90m. they asked if they need to resend events — tell them no for now.
ingest-bot: Incident note created: INC-2026-03-16-2372 — usage-rollup backlog for tenant acme-corp. linked runbooks: ingestion-backlog, kafka-consumer-rebalance.
matt_backend: after restart we should also rotate DB connection pool and check cloud SQL metrics (CPU/IO spike around 03:08). I opened a ticket with cloud-db ops.
ciara_analytics: monitoring: creating an alert for per-tenant hourly rows missing >1 hour so we can auto-detect similar regressions.
alex_sre: follow-up: found one root cause — a malformed event schema from 03:05 that lacked a required `windowing_key` field. it triggered processing exception and consumer rebalanced repeatedly. fixed parser to drop and log malformed items, backfilled the skipped offsets, and hourly aggregates for acme-corp are now appearing in console (first recovered datapoint at 04:12 UTC).
sam_support: customer update sent: escalated, identified malformed payload + transient DB write timeouts, we restarted consumer, backfill completed, charts refreshed. they replied :thumbsup:. closing once we verify 24h stability.
ciara_analytics: note to self: add stricter schema validation upstream and a dead-letter topic for malformed usage events.
matt_backend: postmortem ticket INC-2026-03-16-2372-PM created with action items: schema validation, DB connection pool tuning, consumer retry backoff tuning.
sam_support: thanks team. leaving thread open for any more telemetry we should attach to the incident.
